brief.t: Victor Armendarez’s two-SKU cost breakdown and quote are due today in the CRM. Finish verified pricing for Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel before anything else; do not quote from partial cost inputs.
ALOETALLOW is ready to move: Kyle said “Ready when u are” yesterday. Put a specific reorder meeting on the calendar and confirm quantity and timing today.
Ashley at Earth and Ash replied “Great, thank you” in WhatsApp. Confirm the invoice was received and drive it to payment; do not assume payment has landed.
Diana / ELOIRE was promised dry-shampoo reorder pricing and packaging notes by yesterday’s end of day. There is still no fresh evidence that the delivery went out. Close the loop today.
Ben Kar / Tavro remains a 90-percent, roughly 30,000-unit opportunity with no confirmed proposal or recap delivery. This has sat since June 30. Send the proposal or a concrete recap today.
Jabari’s product call is booked for Saturday at 10:00 AM. Prepare the packaging and customization answers today; he is asking specifically about tubes and containers.
The CRM still shows 11 tasks with 8 overdue. Laura repeated yesterday that customer-page task creation has no usable Assign To list. It remains open and blocks accountable task routing.

next: Finish verified Victor pricing and send both SKU quote materials
Book ALOETALLOW’s reorder meeting and confirm Ashley’s invoice-to-payment status
Send Diana’s overdue ELOIRE pricing, then Tavro’s proposal or decision-driving recap
Prepare Jabari’s Saturday call and hand off the new qualified leads

kb.a: Victor Armendarez has a CRM task due Friday to receive the cost breakdown and quote for both Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel SKUs. The prior narrated update remains authoritative: he must confirm packaging compatibility with his R&D lab, and full cost inputs are still required. Do not present a customer price or production date until that costing is verified.

Kyle at ALOETALLOW wrote “Ready when u are” in WhatsApp on July 23. Treat this as an immediate current-customer reorder opportunity: book a specific meeting and establish quantity, timing, and any changes before quoting or promising production.

Ashley at Earth and Ash replied “Great, thank you” in WhatsApp on July 23 after the invoice workflow. This supports that she received a response, not that payment was made. Confirm invoice receipt and payment status before marking the order collected.

Diana at ELOIRE was promised 500- and 1,000-unit dry-shampoo reorder pricing plus packaging notes by end of day July 23. No fresh email or WhatsApp evidence confirms it was delivered. Send the final verified tiers and notes today, then ask for the reorder decision.

Ben Kar / Tavro remains recorded as 90% close for about 30,000 units of custom tallow and argan-oil skincare. No current source confirms that PLL has sent the proposal or a post-call recap since June 30. Send one today and ask for the deposit or production-timeline decision.

Jabari Bailey has a 10:00 AM Saturday product call with Sam. He has asked how much customization PLL offers for private-label branding, tubes, and containers. Prepare truthful packaging paths and clarify scope, volume, budget, and timing on the call.

Yanay Cabrera / Luxivelle replied July 24 with a qualified custom-haircare request: a hydrating hair mask and bonding hair oil, about 500 units each, targeting next year. She needs custom formulation, samples, packaging, logo printing, labels, and final production. Respond with the development path and next discovery step; do not invent costs or lead times.

Stephen Gould quoted Ephix 25 each of two blank sample-bottle types for $155 including shipping, with a 7–10 day lead time. Aidan must provide a W-9 and sales-tax exemption form to remove tax from the final invoice, then confirm release.

CRM still lists Terra Lotus raw-material sample confirmation and Kenna’s remaining prices/quotes among overdue work. WhatsApp also shows James requesting Terra Lotus tracking early July 24. Verify sample and shipment status before sending any client update.

CRM Development / Issues contains Laura’s latest July 23 request to add a usable assignee dropdown when creating a customer-page task. The dashboard still shows 11 tasks and 8 overdue. No developer resolution or live verification is posted; treat the defect as open.

Rachel at Smooth Crack asked July 23 for the available products for demo purposes and to ensure all scents are accounted for. Sales/operations should send a verified available-product and scent list; do not send an unverified inventory promise.

New brand-development replies need a fast qualification handoff: Grace asked for a call, Arit remains interested and needs MOQ guidance, and Danielle wants a pre-formulated serum and moisturizer but only about 20 units each. Qualify fit and MOQ without offering unsupported small-run commitments.
